FIELD-CONFIRMED on the previously-failing local machine, 2026-07-26 ~17:45 PT, captain-hook 12.20.12 carrying daemonkit v0.20.9. Two-part proof:

(1) The root-caused mechanism is gone: the brew-postinstall retry's diagnostic named the REAL path (/Users/yasyf/Library/LaunchAgents/com.yasyf.capt-hook.helper.plist — realhome working under the sandboxed temp HOME) and launchd produced zero bootstrap EPERM/EIO. The old failure mode cannot recur: no user-home-derived durable path is $HOME-resolved any more.

(2) End-to-end convergence through daemonkit's own caller: `capt-hookd package-install` (the exact post_install entry point) from an unsandboxed shell fresh-installed cleanly — bundle 12.20.12 delivered to ~/Applications, sealed activation/apply receipts, KEYLESS helper plist written by daemonkit at the real path, host.v1 (PID 81227) and helper (PID 81205) both bootstrapped by daemonkit exit-0, `capt-hook helper status` → "helper v12.20.12 ok=True". The machine had been wedged at bundle 12.20.9 since Jul 25.

Scope note: the ORIGINAL closure wording ("converges through brew postinstall") is unachievable for a different, now-separately-filed reason — Homebrew's formula post_install sandbox denies file-write-create in ~/Library/LaunchAgents at any path (captain-hook backlog 0ef22da, packaging-layer fix). That is not this investigation's mechanism: this premise was about the caller-context-dependent bootstrap EIO, whose cause (temp-HOME path resolution) is fixed and field-verified on both machines (home's separate Background-key cell closed live earlier the same day).
